comportamentos: Remove the process from the processes list when a tied candidate uses up its last vacancy (decrease_vacancies_and_check_remaining! returns false): missing. The candidate reworks how the counters are decremented but never deletes the exhausted process, so later candidates can still be assigned to it.
Require letter_template when the admission process has letters: present but differs. The candidate validates only when min_letters > 0, while the official fix uses the has_letters condition.
Relax max_greater_than_min_letters to run whenever both min and max are set: missing.
justificativa: The letter-template validation is roughly covered, but the tie-handling fix (removing a process with no remaining vacancies from the ranking loop) is not implemented; the candidate only changes the counter arithmetic, which does not match the official behavior.
